reviews.title: Value and performance
reviews.comment: The quality and the price of this product is amazing. I was using AIO to cool my 5950X, started to failed. I decided to switch to Air cooler and was looking for something that will perform well. I was recommended this product and saw it was performing just like my old AIO when I bought it new. The temps during gaming are around 65-80C which is crazy good in my opinion. In some games I seem the temps below 65 around 50s. Keeping in mine the room temperature and my 5950X pair it with a FE 3090 Ti. Really happy with this purchase and I would recommend this product. It was easy to install as well to program the lcd screen with their software. I will be getting a second one for my wife next :)
reviews.author: John&Jen91

reviews.title: Who says you can't have your cake and eat it too?!
reviews.comment:
Works great for my 9800X3D! Just be careful with RAM clearance, it's a tight fit if you have RAM with RGB/Heatsinks. But it keeps temps at 40-42°C at idle and about 60°C in game using MX-6 thermal paste. The cooler itself is excellent and the screen is highly customizable with various stats like temp, utilization, fan RPM, watt usage and the like. It's a bit pricier than your normal cooler, but just as effective as an AIO and very, very quiet. The two fans connect via a splitter into a single header, so no need to take more than the one CPU_FAN header for both included fans.
The TRCC app only controls the LCD display and not the fans, but that can be set in the BIOS. Default settings keep things cool and quiet so I haven't messed with any of that as of yet. It was fairly simple to install, just make sure you have a long screw driver for the brackets; you won't reach it with a normal one.

reviews.title: Love this
reviews.comment: Absolutely love this. I had CPU and GPU temps displayed on my screen and was tired of it being there. Was looking for one of the smaller monitoring screens to do that then came across this cooler. Glad I got it. It's on a 7800x3d and the cooler keeps the temps on that under control and can see my temps at a glance. No more annoying display on my monitor. The TCC software works well.

reviews.title: Not just amazing, but TheMazing (awesome cooler)
reviews.comment: Wow, this thing keeps my 14700k coolies (idling at 38-39degC; under load 70-75degC) and Fiji is quite hot hot hot right now (average room temps range from 26-30 with spikes to 32degC (without AirCon). Haven't tired this on my 9950x3d but I have a feeling it will manage it fine (temps might obviously be higher than say using the noctua d15 G2 which has 08 pipes). If you want to stick to longevity, go air cooling but if you can afford 3-5 year cpu cooling updates/maintenance, then go AIO/ liquid cooling. This cooler is noice to the max (lcd setup and display is noooooice). Yes would buy again (if i can afford to build more machines given the tech arbitrariness atm..some call it greed but business is business and the little consumer seems to never be right these days eh). Oh well, so long and thanks for all the fish. Cooler is awesome, vinaka (thanks) to Thermalright (more like ThermalTight eh eh eeehhhhhh) and Amazon. Moce (bye).
